comment: Issue #4633: the per-test-name parity baseline for the repo self-migration gate. Every mirrored test project is compared NAME FOR NAME with its C# original: the shards list the C# cases (cs2gs capture-test-oracle, display names forced to Namespace.Class.Method(args)) and compare them with the migrated run's TRX. Any case the C# original discovers that the migrated run did not execute ('missing'), and any migrated case the C# original does not have ('extra'), fails the app unless an entry here explains it. Kinds: 'missing' and 'extra' name ONE exact display name; 'rows' names one theory METHOD (Ns.Class.Method, no argument list) and excuses its rows only when the missing and extra row counts are equal, i.e. a value renders differently in G# but no row was lost. Rules, enforced by Cs2Gs.Pipeline/TestNameParityBaseline.cs: 'app' is the literal .csproj app id; no wildcards; 'reason' (>= 24 chars) and 'issue' ('#<number>') are mandatory; an entry that stops matching is reported as stale (advisory) so the list shrinks as fixes land. A difference caused by a cs2gs or gsc defect is a P0 self-migration bug and its entry must cite that issue. Not the same file as selfmig-test-allowlist.json, which excuses FAILING cases; this one answers which cases EXIST.
